digest.component_or_area: rebar plan-review, Jira reconciler, CLI registry, BindingStore, code-review/plan-review gates
propositions: Five recovered approved-but-lossy refactor proposals (RP-02 through RP-06) require evidence-backed decision-ready briefs covering architectural intent, hard-won bug/test behavior, and implementation-critical ambiguities before becoming implementation stories.
RP-02 requires ordered exact-match retirement recovery at a validated live-operation boundary, with durable tombstone-first semantics and no-op repeat behavior for atomicity.
RP-03 requires scoped finite-pass fuse and retry envelope with 3 physical attempts maximum, 15s cumulative sleep, authoritative Jira rate scopes, and one observe/replan cycle.
RP-04/RP-05 require centralized operation-snapshot composition, unified CLI registry with canonical package-data help, and pre-operation routing before config/store/handler materialization.

RP-06 requires effective-policy unification, typed discovery trace, Option-B failure policy preserving successes/skipping dependents/continuing independent units, and explicit `review-plan --retry` override with fresh budget per invocation.
